subject: Re: Training on customer data - opt-out confirmation
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmefin.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmefin.io>
Date: 2026-08-22T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Training on customer data - opt-out request

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the call earlier - useful to walk through Redwood's hosting options. A few follow-ups from our security and legal teams:

- AcmeFin needs written confirmation that any data sent to Redwood's hosted API will not be used to train or improve Redwood models unless we explicitly opt in.
- We need clarity on PII handling: are request/response payloads stored, for how long, and what redaction controls exist?
- Data residency: all logs and customer data for AcmeFin must remain in US (preferably us-west) datacenters.
- Logging controls: ability to disable request/response logging and to restrict what metadata is retained.
- We also need a SOC 2 summary and the current DPA that covers data processing and model training clauses.

Can you confirm Redwood will apply a training-opt-out flag for AcmeFin and provide the SOC2/DPA artifacts? If you need a signed addendum, let me know and I can circulate.

Appreciate a short email we can share with legal.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform, AcmeFin
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmefin.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Training on customer data - opt-out request

Alex - thanks for the clear summary and for raising the legal/security asks. Recap + confirmation below so you can share with your team:

1) Training opt-out
- Redwood can and will register AcmeFin on a model-improvement opt-out. That means AcmeFin request/response payloads will not be used to train or fine-tune Redwood models or placed into any model improvement pipelines.
- Opt-out can be applied at the account or route level; please confirm which you prefer (account-level is typical for vendor-managed deployments).

2) PII handling and logging controls
- By default we collect minimal metadata for debugging (request id, model, latency). Request/response bodies are logged only if debugging is enabled by your team.
- We support automatic redaction rules (email, SSN, credit card patterns) on request bodies before storage. We also support a strict no-logging mode where request/response payloads are not persisted at all.
- You can request per-route logging configuration; we will document the exact fields retained.

3) Retention and data residency
- Default transient retention for request logs is 30 days. We can extend to 90 days per contract.
- We support data residency controls; AcmeFin data can be restricted to our US regions (we will pin to us-west).

4) Security & encryption
- Data encrypted in transit (TLS) and at rest. Support for customer-managed keys (KMS) is available for Private/Dedicated and select Hosted tiers.

5) Artifacts and next steps
- Attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC 2 summary) and DPA-RI-v3.pdf (standard DPA with model training clauses called out).
- I will open a support ticket (RI-789102) to track the opt-out request and will coordinate with our SRE team to apply the account-level flag.
- Timeline: once we receive written confirmation from AcmeFin (email reply ok), we'll apply the opt-out and update config within 48 business hours and confirm back.

If you want the opt-out reflected in an executed contract, we can generate a short amendment to the DPA for signature - happy to coordinate that.

Next steps for you: please reply to this thread confirming you want account-level opt-out and whether you want retention set to 30 or 90 days. Also attach any signed DPA if you have it.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra

Thanks Rishi - confirmed.

- AcmeFin requests an account-level training opt-out (apply to all routes).
- Set retention to 90 days for logs.
- Please enable strict no-logging mode for any route we mark as "sensitive" and apply automatic PII redaction rules as described.

I've attached a signed copy of our DPA amendment indicating the opt-out. Please confirm once the flag is applied and share the ticket number for our tracking.

Thanks,
Alex
